description: Prompt for finding a problem's root cause — reproduced, traced back, attributed to the harness, the project or the operator, with evidence — and what it means for the sprint

input-arguments.name: ticket
input-arguments.description: Ticket the finding came from, when it came from one

needs-fix.description: true if there is a real problem to fix

summary.description: The problem in one line, 120 characters or fewer

root-cause.description: The root cause, and the chain from it to the symptoms

cause-in.description: Where the cause is, not where it showed: the harness (off-board ticket), the project (ticketing-system ticket), or the operator's own machine (off-board ticket)

evidence.description: What proves each claim: a command and its first error line, file:line, a log line; unchecked claims marked unverified

blocks-tickets.description: Keys of the tickets whose own history, change-log or files show this failure

must-interrupt-work.description: true if fixing it means pausing agent work on a shared resource

can-continue-without-fix.description: true if the highest-priority workable ticket can still progress without the fix

needs-human.description: true if the fix needs the operator's own uncommitted work (stash, commit, discard, reset, branch switch on their changes) or a credential (token, key, password, login, re-authentication)

human-action.description: What the operator must do, in one line; empty when needs-human is false

pause-tickets.description: Keys of only the tickets that must pause so the fix can be built, tested and deployed; empty when needs-human is true
